page.notes: Left margin notes: "l" 1.Sam. 24 verf.7.; "m" 1.Sa.26. 9.; "n" Contra Ad'mant.c. 17. (word "Ad'mant" doubtful, possibly Adamant.); "o" Loco 49. Institut.Theo.
